question: An agent sells a pan with a marked price of ₹6,420 at a discount of 30%. What is the selling price (in ₹) of the pan?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The discount given is 30% on the marked price.

Therefore, the Selling Price (SP) is (100 − 30)% = 70% of the Marked Price.

SP = 70% of 6420 = (70 ÷ 100) × 6420

SP = 7 × 642 = 4494

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,494.**
